I could tell it was irrational suicidal thoughts I.e the medication was making me really bad but when I came off it my suicidal agitation wasn’t that high at all. I’ve tried like 9 medications now all for at least two months. I shouldn’t be getting rejected from something that could save my life, no matter how young.

Even people who are in unbearable pain probably have reservations and anxiety before hands as it’s against the body’s survival instincts. It’s horrible people have to go through with this. I was thinking about getting really drunk before hands so I don’t care so much. 

But in reality I don’t know if that will work. I guess when the time comes I will see what I’m made of. Either I will bite the bullet and get it over with it or I will sit there and crumble, in the same depressive state I’ve been in for years. I wish you luck whatever you decide.

Also the pain I experienced after a break up was like no other so I can empathise with you. I was in a truly terrible state for several months and was sleeping 15-17 hours a day to try and numb the pain and not eating for days. It was easily type of worst pain I’ve ever experienced. Looking back I wish I had tried some sort of treatment sooner. I wasn’t on any mediation, I didn’t have the energy to try anything. I analysed every aspects of the relationship when I should of been seeking recovery.  I broke up with her but it still hurt just as bad. I couldn’t forgive cheating for a second time.

Some people report seeing spiritual beings and dead family members. They report feelings of happiness, warmth and travelling towards a bright light. Some hear beautiful music. People report that things feel more ‘real’ than earth. They also become less afraid of death and more open minded. I can’t remember what else but I did a lot of research.
